title: Phase 2：序列關係挖掘第四個結果：A336662（Manhattan 格子無接觸自避路徑）= 2·A189722（一直轉彎的蛇），並更正 A337353 的公式下標

A336662.proof: edge-midpoint map W -> q (Watson 1970 covering-lattice bijection made explicit): contacts of q <-> shared vertices of W; turn rule of q equals the Manhattan orientation rule; reflection x<->y gives the factor 2. Brute force n <= 16, map checked on all 32767 walks m <= 16. No Lean.

A337353.proof: a(n) = 8*A189722(n) by symmetry (no reversal possible), then H1; the existing formula a(n) = 4*A336662(n) is off by one (fails at n=1).

novelty.note: The relation is recorded in OEIS: A337353 has the (unproved) formula a(n) = 4*A336662(n), which is off by one index; A337353(n) = 8*A189722(n) is an elementary symmetry and A322419 already has 4*A189722(n). So A336662(k) = 2*A189722(k+1) is the index-corrected form of an existing OEIS formula: SUPPORTED_KNOWN. Contribution: index correction of A337353 plus a short proof (Watson 1970 covering-lattice bijection made explicit; the Manhattan identification was not found stated in the sources read). Not claimed as new.
